blocks.text: Libraries bane banaye toolkits hain jinhein sara code khud likhe baghair istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Aayiye kuch aasan misaalon se dekhein ke libraries kaise import aur istemal hoti hain.
Misaal: random library import kar ke random (koi bhi, pehle se maloom na hone wale) numbers banayein.

import random
# Generate a random number between 1 and 10
number = random.randint(1, 10)
print("The random number is:", number)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import random": Python ki random library program mein laayi jati hai.
"# Generate a random number between 1 and 10": comment.
"number = random.randint(1, 10)": 1 se 10 tak (dono shamil) koi bhi poora number chunta hai.
"print("The random number is:", number)": chuna hua number dikhata hai.
Output: "The random number is: " ke baad 1 se 10 tak koi number; har Run par alag ho sakta hai, is liye pehle se nahi bataya ja sakta.
Khud try karein: randint(1, 10) ko randint(1, 6) kar ke kai baar Run karein: dice (paasa) ki tarah 1 se 6 tak number aayenge.
Misaal: dates aur time (waqt) ke liye datetime library import karein.

import datetime
# Get the current date and time
current_time = datetime.datetime.now()
print("Current date and time:", current_time)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import datetime": dates aur waqt wali library program mein aati hai.
"# Get the current date and time": comment.
"current_time = datetime.datetime.now()": pehla datetime library ka naam hai, doosra us ke andar ki class; now() abhi ki tareekh aur waqt deta hai.
"print("Current date and time:", current_time)": tareekh aur waqt dikhata hai.
Output: "Current date and time: " ke baad abhi ki date aur time, saal-mahina-din ghante:minute:second.microseconds ki shakal mein (maslan 2026-10-28 22:01:30.701856). Har Run par waqt alag hoga.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab pehli line "Import datetime" bare I se chhapti hai; Python mein SyntaxError aata hai. Keyword chhote letters mein hai: import datetime.
Misaal: statistics (data ke hisaab kitaab) ke liye statistics library import karein.

import statistics
# Calculate the mean of a list of numbers
data = [23, 45, 67, 89, 12, 44, 56]
mean_value = statistics.mean(data)
print("The mean value is:", mean_value)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import statistics": statistics library program mein aati hai.
"data = [23, 45, 67, 89, 12, 44, 56]": saat numbers ki list.
"mean_value = statistics.mean(data)": mean (ausat) = sab ka jor / ginti = 336 / 7 = 48.
"print("The mean value is:", mean_value)": jawab dikhata hai. Sab numbers integer hain aur jawab poora 48 banta hai, is liye 48.0 nahi balke 48 chhapta hai.
Output: The mean value is: 48
Khud try karein: list mein 56 ko 63 kar ke Run karein: jor 343 hoga aur mean 49 aayega.
statistics library se mean (ausat), median (beech wali value) aur mode (sab se zyada aane wali value) nikalein. marks ki list badal kar Run karein.

import statistics
marks = [72, 85, 64, 85, 90]
print("Mean:", statistics.mean(marks))
print("Median:", statistics.median(marks))
print("Mode:", statistics.mode(marks))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import statistics": statistics library aati hai.
"marks = [72, 85, 64, 85, 90]": paanch marks ki list.
"statistics.mean(marks)": ausat: 396 / 5 = 79.2.
"statistics.median(marks)": tarteeb se lagayein (64, 72, 85, 85, 90); beech wali value 85.
"statistics.mode(marks)": sab se zyada baar aane wali value: 85 (do baar).
Output: "Mean: 79.2", "Median: 85", "Mode: 85".
Khud try karein: 64 ko 100 kar ke Run karein: Mean 86.4 ho jayega, Median aur Mode 85 hi rahenge.
Mukhtasar yeh ke libraries se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai, aur aap pahiya dobara banane ki bajaye (yani jo cheez pehle se bani hai usay dobara banane ki bajaye) apni asal problem par dhyan dete hain.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Library import karte waqt sirf woh import karein jo zaroori ho. Aur libraries https://docs.python.org/3/ par dekhein (kitab mein yeh pata spaces aur comma ke saath chhapa hai).
